sections.heading: 1. General provisions
sections.body: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the REACT LAB website (the "Service"). By registering for or using the Service, you confirm that you have read and accept these Terms in full. If you do not agree with any part of these Terms, please do not use the Service.

sections.heading: 2. Registration and account
sections.body: Some features of the Service may require registration. You agree to provide accurate information when registering and to keep it up to date. You are responsible for safeguarding your account credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account.

sections.heading: 3. User rights and obligations
sections.body: When using the Service, you agree not to violate applicable law, not to post content that infringes the rights of third parties, not to attempt unauthorized access to the Service's systems, and not to use the Service to distribute spam or malicious software.

sections.heading: 4. Content and intellectual property
sections.body: All materials on the Service, including text, design, logos, and source code, are intellectual property protected by law. Using these materials without the rights holder's permission is prohibited, except as permitted by law.

sections.heading: 5. Limitation of liability
sections.body: The Service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any damages arising from the use, or inability to use, the Service, including downtime, errors, or data loss.

sections.heading: 6. Changes to the Terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms at any time. The current version is always available on this page. Continued use of the Service after changes are made constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

sections.heading: 7. Contact
sections.body: For any questions regarding these Terms, please reach out through the contact form on the website.

sections.heading: 1. Data we collect
sections.body: We may collect the following data: name, email address, password (encrypted), as well as technical information such as IP address, device and browser type, and cookies.

sections.heading: 2. How we use data
sections.body: The data we collect is used to register and authenticate users, provide the Service's features, communicate with you (for example, to confirm registration or reset your password), and improve the quality of the Service.

sections.heading: 3. Cookies
sections.body: The Service uses cookies to remember your preferences (such as interface language and theme) and to keep you signed in. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though this may limit some features.

sections.heading: 4. Sharing data with third parties
sections.body: We do not share personal data with third parties, except where required by law or necessary to operate the Service (for example, a hosting provider or an email service used to send notifications).

sections.heading: 5. Data storage and protection
sections.body: Data is retained for as long as necessary for the purposes it was collected for, or until you delete your account. We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us through the contact form or your account settings.

sections.heading: 7. Changes to this Policy
sections.body: We may update this Policy from time to time. The current version is always available on this page. We recommend reviewing it periodically.

sections.heading: 8. Contact
sections.body: For questions about how we handle personal data, please reach out through the contact form on the website.

sections.heading: 1. What cookies are
sections.body: Cookies are small files that a browser stores on your device when you visit a website. They help operate the website, remember settings, and understand how the Service is used.

sections.heading: 2. Strictly necessary cookies
sections.body: We use technically necessary cookies to operate authentication and protect forms: session cookies, CSRF protection cookies, and cookies that store the return URL after sign-in. Some Service features may not work correctly without them.

sections.heading: 3. Preferences
sections.body: Your theme preference is stored in the browser's local storage (localStorage), not in a cookie. This lets us retain your chosen appearance on later visits.

sections.heading: 4. Analytics and advertising
sections.body: We may add analytics, advertising, and other non-essential cookies to measure audiences, improve the Service, and show relevant content. Before enabling these technologies, we will implement the required consent mechanism and list their providers, purposes, and retention periods in this Policy.

sections.heading: 5. Third-party technologies
sections.body: When third-party analytics or advertising services are enabled, their providers may set cookies. We will update this page with those services and links to their privacy policies.

sections.heading: 6. Managing cookies
sections.body: You can delete and block cookies in your browser settings. Blocking strictly necessary cookies may limit access to authentication and other Service features. You will be able to change non-essential cookie settings through the consent mechanism once it is available on the website.

sections.heading: 7. Changes to this Policy
sections.body: We may update this Policy when the technologies we use change. The current version is always available on this page.
